question: Does a T1 Inquiry Intent profile add future scheduled-visit signal beyond Persona, Search Need, Spot and Broker profiles?
hypothesis: An unsupervised profile of channel, visit request, urgency, message length, requested area/budget and inquiry timing improves future average precision and lift.
primary_change: Add an unsupervised Inquiry Intent profile and its interactions at T1.

target.censoring: The public data has no visit timestamp; the recorded inquiry response is treated as the observed proxy outcome and this limitation is reported.

population.eligibility: Inquiries after a frozen early profile-calibration window; the final 20% by inquiry_at is held out for future evaluation.
exclusions: The first 30% of inquiries are reserved only for unsupervised profile calibration and are not used to fit the predictive models.

validation.split_description: First 30% of inquiries calibrate/freeze unsupervised profiles; next 50% train the predictive model; final 20% are an untouched future test.

items.source: inquiries fields available at inquiry creation: channel, message_length, requested area/budgets, urgency_days, asked_visit and inquiry timestamp
items.evidence: The profile excludes broker_response and broker_response_hours; its clusterer is fitted only on the early calibration window and frozen.

items.source: derived from inquiry_intent_profile and previously reviewed profile IDs
items.evidence: No future broker response data is introduced.
